topic: pinned-install journey: the README the front-page pin delivers must itself run the consumer journey
hypothesis: The install-surface fix (97c8c79) repaired the consumer journey on main AFTER v0.4.1 was tagged; a stranger following the front-page pin receives the TAG's README, so the two measured dead-ends still ship to every pinned install.
method: git show <tag>:README.md grep counts; npm pack of an exported tag worktree (the bytes a github:#<tag> install receives); fresh installs from the PUBLIC tag into empty apps; journey commands extracted verbatim from the SHIPPED README and executed; contract test written first (test/installed-tag-journey.test.mjs).
